digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge git push delivery and merge recovery
key_entities: could not fetch from promisor remote
propositions: Bridge git push abandons a converged reconcile after a single transient transport failure (TLS, DNS, timeout, promisor fetch) because non-fast-forward retry logic does not distinguish between permanent rule violations and retriable transport faults.

The current push.py classifier treats all non-fast-forward push failures identically, routing both policy declines and transport errors to the same terminal branch that raises immediately without retry.

Both the explicit fetch in merge recovery and the on-demand promisor fetch within git merge fail with transport errors but receive no retries, causing unpushed commits to be silently lost when the runner is recycled.

The fix must add a transport-retriable classifier, bounded retry budget (3 attempts per leg), and backoff (0.5s, 2.0s) while preserving terminal behavior for policy declines and genuine merge conflicts.
Code relocation from push.py to a new push_classify.py module is required to stay under the 800-LOC hard cap while adding failure classification, backoff, and reporting logic.
